pairs.resume:
Recruiter managing end-to-end recruitment for technical roles. Run onboarding for new hires, maintain records in our HRIS, and communicate daily with hiring stakeholders. Partner with three engineering managers on hiring plans, run weekly candidate reviews and keep our pipeline organised. Managed 40 open roles last year and improved time-to-hire by three weeks. Wrote interview guides and trained new interviewers.
Selected projects: rebuilt the onboarding checklist for two teams, shortened the first-week schedule and collected feedback from every new hire. Earlier, I supported a graduate hiring round, scheduled 30 interviews and kept candidates informed at every stage. Outside work, I volunteer with a local careers group and help school leavers with their first applications. References are available on request.
pairs.job_description: Recruiter. Required: Recruitment, Onboarding, HRIS, Communication and Stakeholder Management. You will partner with engineering managers, run weekly hiring reviews and keep our candidate pipeline organised. Workday experience is preferred.
pairs.notes: All five requirements are explicitly evidenced.

pairs.resume: HR generalist supporting human resources operations. Handle employee relations cases and monthly payroll, and maintain HR trackers in Excel.
pairs.job_description: HR generalist. Required: Human Resources, Employee Relations, Performance Management, Payroll and Excel. You will be the first point of contact for employees and managers, support the annual review cycle and work with our external payroll provider. This is a full-time role based in our Lahore office. We offer health cover, a learning budget and a yearly team offsite. Our interview process includes a short screening call and one team interview. The office is close to public transport.
pairs.notes: Performance Management is required but not evidenced.

pairs.resume: Learning and development specialist. Design training and development programmes, run onboarding workshops and deliver public speaking sessions for new managers. Strong written communication.
pairs.job_description: Learning and development specialist. Required: Training and Development, Onboarding, Communication and Public Speaking.
pairs.notes: All four requirements are explicitly evidenced.

pairs.resume: Office administrator. Manage calendars, order supplies and maintain Microsoft Office documents. Supported a recruitment fair once.
pairs.job_description: HR coordinator. Required: Recruitment, HRIS, Onboarding and Microsoft Office.
pairs.notes: A single recruitment-fair mention is thin but is still genuine evidence of the Recruitment requirement.

pairs.resume: HR operations assistant. Maintain employee records in Google Sheets, update our HRIS and support monthly payroll.
pairs.job_description: HR operations assistant. Required: Excel or Google Sheets, HRIS and Payroll.
pairs.notes: Google Sheets satisfies the spreadsheet alternative; Excel is not a separate gap.

pairs.resume: HR assistant with HRIS administration and recruitment coordination experience. I have no payroll experience.
pairs.job_description: Payroll officer. Required: Payroll, HRIS and Recruitment support.

resume_negated_terms.reason: resume says there is no payroll experience

pairs.notes: The negated Payroll mention must not satisfy the requirement.

pairs.resume: Talent acquisition lead managing a team of three recruiters. Own recruitment strategy, partner with stakeholders and maintain hiring data in our HRIS. Recently started using data analysis for funnel metrics. Selected projects: coordinated a hiring event for twenty candidates, kept the schedule and candidate notes current, and walked new colleagues through their first-week checklist.
pairs.job_description: Talent acquisition lead. Required: Recruitment, Stakeholder Management, Team Management, HRIS and Data Analysis. You will join a team of nine, work with engineering and commercial leaders and present a quarterly hiring review to the senior team. This is a full-time role with two remote days each week.

evidence.Team Management: managing a team of three recruiters

pairs.notes: All five requirements are evidenced, although Data Analysis is recent.

pairs.resume: Payroll specialist processing monthly payroll for 300 staff. Reconcile tax filings and maintain payroll models in Excel.
pairs.job_description: Payroll specialist. Required: Payroll, Excel and Taxation.
pairs.notes: All three requirements are explicitly evidenced.

pairs.resume: HR business partner supporting two business units. Advise managers on employee relations and performance management, mediate conflict resolution cases and maintain human resources policies. Present monthly updates to leadership.
pairs.job_description: HR business partner. Required: Employee Relations, Performance Management, Conflict Resolution, Communication and Human Resources.
pairs.notes: Presenting updates implies communication, but the resume does not state the Communication requirement, so it is labelled missing rather than assumed.

pairs.resume: Retail team member. Assisted customers, stocked shelves and trained new staff on the till.
pairs.job_description: HR intern. Required: Human Resources, Recruitment, Onboarding, Communication and Microsoft Office.
pairs.notes: Retail work does not evidence any of the five HR requirements.
